title: With no sort chosen, tracked parts are listed before untracked parts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Four parts at {Location-A} have numbers starting {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSORT-).
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSORT-02, described ZZAUTOTEST PL NOSORT ALPHA) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSORT-01, described ZZAUTOTEST PL NOSORT CHARLIE) are tracked.
  • Inventory parts {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSORT-04, described ZZAUTOTEST PL NOSORT AARDVARK) and {Part-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOSORT-03, described ZZAUTOTEST PL NOSORT ZULU) are untracked.
  • No column of the Inventory list is sorted: no header shows a sort arrow.
custom_steps:
1. Type {Prefix-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Read the four rows from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Order: {Part-A}, {Part-B} (the tracked parts, ALPHA then CHARLIE, description A to Z), then {Part-C}, {Part-D} (the untracked parts, AARDVARK then ZULU). AARDVARK sorts first alphabetically but still comes after both tracked parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S6-R9, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.7 (the untracked row sits below the tracked rows), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Tech plan Phase 5 (no sort: tracked first, then description A to Z); Product's 7 Oct comment, item 6 (Default Sorting ships after Part Lifecycle). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R9: “With no sort chosen, tracked parts are listed first and untracked parts after them, each ordered by description, A to Z.”
